newsitem.title: USA: PSE to trade LEAPS on Dean Witter.
newsitem.headline: PSE to trade LEAPS on Dean Witter.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Tuesday it would begin trading LEAPS (long term equity anticipation securities) on Dean Witter, Discover & Co on March 5.
The exchange said the LEAPS would have expirations in January 1998 and January 1999, with initial strike prices of 30, 40 and 50.
The stock was down 1/4 at 39-3/8 Tuesday afternoon.
Dean Witter LEAPS will also be available at the American Stock Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
